intent: Put a pointer in front of a person: how many approvals and questions are waiting in Jason, and where to look. Nothing about the work itself travels.

failure_codes.when: the service did not answer, or answered that it cannot take messages for now
the service answered that it will not take this message
the service refused the credential, or needs one and none was granted

conformance: Sends what it is given and nothing more: the title, the message and the counts, never a field of its own making.
Answers notification_unreachable for a service that did not answer or is unavailable for now, so the runtime tries once more.
Answers notification_refused or notification_unauthorized for an answer that will not change by trying again.
Returns at most a receipt: the service's own identifier for the message, at most 256 characters.
Keeps its credential out of the binding, out of what it logs and out of what it returns: it reads it with host.env.
